user.title: Your house
user.description: What Sunhold reads to understand the weather and the house. Only the forecast and an outdoor temperature are required; each optional sensor unlocks more.

data_description.outdoor_temperature: A shaded sensor. One warmed by the sun reads high and skews the model.
data_description.sun_sensor: Measured sun. Lets Sunhold learn how far the forecast can be trusted, and check at 10:30 that the sun came.
data_description.pv_power: With whole-house and heat pump power, enables the summer solar gate.
data_description.heat_pump_power: Lets the winter model learn from mornings when the heating ran.
data_description.notify_service: For example notify.mobile_app_phone. Summaries carry Too cold / Just right / Too warm buttons.

solar_thresholds.name: Solar thresholds
solar_thresholds.description: What the panels must spare for the heat pump, in W (solar power minus the house without the pump). Change them if your solar setup changes.

data.learn_summer_thresholds: Learn the summer pair from the heat pump

data_description.winter_surplus_on_w: Held for 20 minutes before a zone is heated up to store the sun.
data_description.winter_surplus_off_w: Held for 10 minutes before the boost ends.
data_description.summer_cut_w: Held for 10 minutes, and only while the heat pump runs.
data_description.learn_summer_thresholds: After about 33 hours of cooling, replace the summer pair with values from the pump's measured draw. Off: the pair above always applies.

user.title: Zone
user.description: One thermostat zone. Sunhold only reads the thermostat; follow its entities to drive the device.

data.name: Name
data.openings: Doors and windows that pause it

data_description.climate: Read only: its heat/cool mode gives the season, and a person changing its set point is learned from.
data_description.openings: Pause after 5 minutes open, resume 2 minutes after closing.
data_description.winter_target: The temperature this zone should reach. Learned feedback adjusts it.
data_description.summer_target: Above this by 1 °C, a solar pause ends.
data_description.sun_floor: While holding for the sun, heat only below this.
data_description.window_pause_heat: While a window is open, heat only below this.
data_description.summer_pause: While paused in summer, cool only above this.
